name: physkit
description: A dual-use toolkit for rigorous physical-science work: a general layer of skills for framing problems, verifying results, designing simulations, debugging, and reporting; and a campaign layer that scaffolds and runs autonomous-research loops. Honesty and independent verification are the frozen core.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous physics-research skills + an autonomous-research campaign layer
interface.longDescription: Frame, verify, simulate, debug, and report physical-science work, or scaffold and operate a rigor-gated autonomous research campaign with reproducible records and independent verification.
defaultPrompt: Verify this result independently before I rely on it.
